en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a narrow street with groups of people standing and walking. At the center stands an ornate neo‑Gothic structure with pointed arches and pinnacles, built into a raised terrace and staircase. Historic buildings and a gatehouse line the street on the left, with trees on the right. At the bottom margin, printed red text reads the city name and a description of the place, with a handwritten signature below.
